correctness.rationale: The symbolic base-b carry normal form is exact on every finite lsd-first word. A high-digit padding argument converts indicator equality into congruence equality; the b^K minus offset construction then proves all offset-residue pairs inequivalent. For b>=3, quotient levels t>=2 are disjoint; t=0 contributes all m residues and t=1 contributes exactly the digit-count residues of [0,c). This gives an exhaustive state count, including zero shifts and all boundary values. The two adjacent-power formulas follow from singletons and complete maximal-digit count ranges; they yield difference r-m for r>=m. The stand-alone finite verifier independently minimizes 4140 parametric automata and checks 40000 outputs; the infinite proof does not depend on those tests.

value.rationale: A complete all-shift minimal-automaton classification for the maximal-digit residue family, including the recently introduced base-four mod-three automatic sequence, determines a natural exact invariant for infinitely many parameters. State minimality is structural rather than an unverified constructed bound. The sharp adjacent-power comparison gives unbounded one-step decreases r-m in state count, exposing a nonmonotonicity not implied by known generic automata bounds. The digit-interval formula has a finite digit-DP implementation with no brute-force interval enumeration.
